# PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Nord Sengeafsnit

PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Nord Sengeafsnit is a psychiatric inpatient ward ("Sengeafsnit") appearing in the 2024 ADHD quality database report, where it is recorded as achieving 0% fulfillment of Indicator 10 [^src1][^src2]. This indicator measures the share of adult treatment courses in which a patient's need for social support was assessed no later than 120 days after the start of treatment [^src1][^src2]. The unit's result is explicitly flagged as resting on a very limited data foundation [^src1][^src2], with the underlying figures shown as "0 (0-84)" — indicating zero recorded fulfilling cases out of a small and uncertain denominator [^src1][^src2].

This result must be read against the broader national picture: 2024 was the first year this indicator was reported at all, and even at the national level fulfillment fell far short of the 90% quality target, landing at just 37%, with regional results ranging from 14% to 52% [^src3]. The steering group behind the ADHD database discussed possible causes for the generally low fulfillment rates, including registration practices and the quality of underlying data from child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and decided to work on improving registration practices going forward [^src3]. PS Almenpsykiatrisk, Nord Sengeafsnit's 0% score, paired with its explicitly limited data base, fits this pattern of measurement and registration difficulties rather than necessarily reflecting a real absence of clinical assessment activity.
